svg.title: LiveClass AI production infrastructure
svg.desc: GitLab CI/CD deploys to an AWS EC2 production host, a GPU Jupyter host, and an auxiliary test and Egress host. The EC2 host runs application, AI, data, media, and object storage services.
svg.text: Current workspace topology · containers, host networks, GPU runtime, tunnels, and CI/CD
single-host Docker deployment · app and media paths are isolated
